entry.name: Fairchild670
Fairchild 670 Vari-Mu Compressor
entry.author: Dandi
entry.changelog: - Initial release with all core features - Variable-Mu with 6386 remote-cutoff tube model - 6AL5 soft rectifier sidechain - Dual-branch auto-release - Transformer emulation - Stereo Link / L/R Independent / Lateral-Vertical - Graphics interface with VU meters - Factory presets
entry.description: Emulation of the legendary Fairchild 670 tube compressor. Features Variable-Mu gain stage, authentic sidechain, transformer emulation, and stereo processing modes.
